body:
## BLOCKED / needs_followup — do not merge

This is an honest existing-corpus remediation, not a canonical-readiness claim. Keep it **OPEN + DRAFT + UNMERGED** while the external authority gap remains open.

- **Bathcat-Authored:** true
- **Audit-Owner:** one wholly fresh Mennonite on the exact live head
- **Base:** `e0e47b2f7593f5ee34c25c5695be9b6bed172afd`
- **Audited old head:** `0cd75ee0e2821d1cb7dd83cd85460d485c6ce69a` — Mennonite `REVISE`
- **Audited prior repaired head:** `1153d5ce0109eb4e9bb6f997cc39d0dc0cc81b7f` — Mennonite `REVISE` (missing operative Graveyard boundary)
- **Repaired exact head:** `2c603ad548a82efd48ad6f2e59b408b189797e5a`

## Exact target / exclusions

English **2016 first/release printing** of *Dead of Winter: The Long Night* (BGG 193037), treated as Plaid Hat's standalone game / standalone expansion. Excludes *Dead of Winter: A Crossroads Game* except explicit compatibility, *Warring Colonies*, Rich Sommer preorder promo, translations, unproven later revisions, Raxxon products outside this box, and digital adaptations.

The live Plaid Hat `rules-tln.pdf` is byte-identical to the immutable 2016-09-10 Wayback capture: 24 pages, 9,026,851 bytes, SHA-256 `dc9002541e8cd7e7273a7ae2d00320fa9b021fd9e77e7e9a0d482999360190e6`. Metadata: InDesign CC 2015, created/modified 2016-07-07. This closes the rulebook revision boundary; metadata alone is not the release proof.

The discovered 2015 FAQ is excluded from target law. Plaid Hat support discovery is bounded to the observed old-path/CDX inventory. Current FFG routes remain Cloudflare-blocked, so no FFG absence claim is made.

## Governing semantic-component ledger

The governing denominator remains **`UNKNOWN`** and no percentage or factual composite is claimed. Card text can override the rulebook. All 16 target OKFs remain `needs_followup`.

- **Card/board/reference classes:** quantities and shared framework are known for 8 dual-sided main objectives; 40 secret/betrayal/exiled objectives; 20 survivors; 165 starting/location items; 22 crises; 10 improvements; 12 experiments; 6 pill side effects; 70 Crossroads; 5 reference sheets; colony board; and 9 location cards. Complete target-printing identities, sides, text, and card-local semantics remain `UNKNOWN`.
- **25 wound tokens:** shared wound/frostbite/death law is closed by the rulebook; physical ordinary/frostbite face printing and distribution remain `UNKNOWN`.
- **20 barricade tokens:** barricade and explosive-trap alternate-state law is closed; physical reverse/alternate printing and distribution remain `UNKNOWN`.
- **20 helpless-survivor tokens:** normal/unruly behavior and flipping are closed; physical sides/distribution remain `UNKNOWN`.
- **12 despair tokens:** wound-like use and despair-only removal are closed; physical printing remains `UNKNOWN`.
- **Food/noise/starvation tokens:** shared spend/search/zombie-risk/starvation-morale procedures are closed; physical faces remain unverified.
- **10 improvement cards + 10 tokens + 12 advancement tokens:** generic threshold/activation/representation law is closed; identities, effects, thresholds, and one-to-one card/token mapping remain `UNKNOWN`.
- **First-player token + 2 track markers:** priority, pass/retain vote, and round/morale tracking are closed; physical faces remain unverified.
- **30 action dice:** ordinary action/random-roll use and Raxxon containment-code placement are closed; physical face printing remains unverified.
- **Exposure die:** blank/wound/frostbite/bitten result classes are closed; physical six-face arrangement and multiplicity remain `UNKNOWN`.
- **Standees/tokens:** ordinary zombie occupancy and zombie-token substitution, survivor correspondence, and bandit framework are closed. Survivor card/standee identities and physical printing remain `UNKNOWN`.
- **12 experiment cards ↔ 19 experiment standees:** Audio Log placement/encounter framework is closed; complete identities and card/standee mapping remain `UNKNOWN`.
- **100 stands + rulebook:** physical support/source pieces, not independent semantic identity classes.

The exact ledger with adjacent Source/Evidence/Confidence triplets is in `scout-report.okf.md`; `sources.okf.md` and `rules/setup.okf.md` carry the consistent open-boundary statement.

## Components and arithmetic

Convention: preserve all **42 printed inventory rows**, including grouped names; sum physical pieces separately. The 9 location cards belong inside the 362-card bucket.

`362 cards + 5 reference sheets + 168 tokens/markers + 89 standees + 100 stands + 1 colony board + 1 rulebook + 31 dice = 757 physical pieces`.

This is aggregate quantity coverage, not identity/side/face/governing-text completeness.

## Repaired core rule coverage

Target-rulebook summaries now cover, with adjacent triplets:

- food demand, failed payment, starvation accumulation, waste, morale effects, zombie demand/noise flips, barricade handling, and overrun deaths;
- crisis contribution, matching/nonmatching scoring, non-exiled-player threshold, printed failure boundary, prevention, overperformance morale, and cleanup;
- search noise and barricade/explosive-trap use;
- Crossroads secret draw, active-player scope, trigger timing, and normal post-action timing;
- zombie/survivor attack resolution, exposure distinctions, and bite-spread decisions.

Printed crisis consequences and all other card-local law remain `UNKNOWN`; no 2014-base or later-revised wording was imported.

## Repaired Long Night / module framework

- **Always-on core:** first-player retention vote; six-sided random-location procedure; despair; normal/unruly helpless survivors; explosive traps; the Graveyard organizes/stores the cards and matching standees of survivors killed during the game and has no gameplay effect except that some Crossroads cards may refer to it.
- **Module boundary:** exactly three optional modules—Improvements, Bandits, Raxxon—in any combination or none; moon/module icons; optional base mixing; combined location decks cut to 20; module-related item/crisis portions ignored when absent.
- **Bandits:** failed placement at full survivor capacity; no-survivor overrun removes bandits; Hideout has no search deck and delegates interaction to its location card. Hideout/card-local text remains `UNKNOWN`.
- **Raxxon:** action-die containment use; beginning-of-colony thumbs-up/thumbs-down/failure timing; special-zombie placement and experiment-card flip; regular-attack requirement, target priority, movement and explosive-trap exceptions; encounter cleanup; explicit experiment-card/standee identity boundary.
- **Instructional scenarios:** Chimp and the Code stages Raxxon access, pills, then containment across R1-R3; Bandit Blitz remains the bounded official staged introduction. Scenario objective/card text remains `UNKNOWN`.

This is not a conventional deckbuilder: the rules establish fixed communal/location/event decks and player hands/followings/equipment, not personal deck acquisition/shuffle/discard construction.

## Visual disposition

The same canonical paths now contain materially reduced, metadata-stripped target-rulebook page overviews:

| File / page | Dimensions | Bytes | SHA-256 |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `01-setup.webp` / p.2 | 300×394 | 18,464 | `400db1ce0942b9696100635a2920025e767d89747fad1b389ade5a7a0c8d2c59` |
| `02-loop.webp` / p.6 | 300×394 | 19,978 | `c42ab3cd8e5259e32dc1ac8f210ba77d4486d0927400ce97a3eea7294a1aff29` |
| `03-tension.webp` / p.16 | 300×394 | 22,444 | `16b0a70ece02040fee8cdd5a8d8b1e221d9fe3f3f70f836c537f75713621e6e6` |
| `04-endgame.webp` / p.18 | 300×394 | 22,174 | `e72d903d803fc5cd61524a8351de73760d6f6fb7d95700f7c15d2383a48e64d6` |
| `contact-sheet.webp` | 600×788 | 83,696 | `0a3fcb28ac5eeaf815651bfbc071a842d375a04826ed77ae2bc266431e844e0f` |

Deterministic Poppler 25.03.0 / FFmpeg 7.1.5 `libwebp` commands and options are in `visuals/packet.okf.md`. Independent inspection of each panel and the sheet confirmed four distinct full-page subjects, no cropping/corruption, no excluded-product/promo/adult-content leakage, and ordinary body text below practical replacement quality while hierarchy remains analytically useful.

## Files / gates

This Graveyard micro-repair changes 2 files: `rules/long-night-core.okf.md` and deterministic `TELEMETRY.md`. Full PR remains scoped to the existing 23 paths.

Passed locally on repaired exact head:

- generated index;
- full OKF validation: 2,623 files clean + fresh index;
- prescribed intake/provenance/visual Node suite: 37 tests, 36 pass, 1 intentional skip, 0 fail;
- diff-aware intake gate: clean;
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`: clean;
- ordinary pre-push hook: 32 tests, 31 pass, 1 intentional skip, 0 fail; intake clean.

Exact-head CI: [`validate` run 30625640320](https://github.com/no-trbl-2-u/game-knowledge-base/actions/runs/30625640320) completed **SUCCESS** on `head_sha=2c603ad548a82efd48ad6f2e59b408b189797e5a`; substantive job [`91140134694`](https://github.com/no-trbl-2-u/game-knowledge-base/actions/runs/30625640320/job/91140134694).

## Residual external help

1. Confirmed English 2016 first-print physical inspection with SKU/lot/printing markers and rule-bearing identity/semantics, without replacement-quality publication.
2. Manual authoritative current FFG support inventory past Cloudflare.
3. Independently bounded target FAQ/errata/module-sheet inventory.

**Audit and merge disposition: one wholly fresh Mennonite on the exact live head; T remains final company authority. This open-gap PR is DO NOT MERGE.**
